mapper.select: select audit_id, submission_id, group_id, action, before_status, after_status, audit_user_id, audit_opinion, audit_time from task_submission_audit where submission_id = #{submissionId} order by audit_id
mapper.insert: insert into task_submission_audit (submission_id, group_id, action, before_status, after_status, audit_user_id, audit_opinion, audit_time) values (#{submissionId}, #{groupId}, #{action}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{auditUserId}, #{auditOpinion}, #{auditTime})
